routes.title: The Bite Was Already Hers
routes.universal_relationship_truth: Some love makes tiny personal things become shared without anyone announcing it.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: She takes the roti bite right after he tears it open.
routes.concrete_proof_beat: The prepared bite keeps moving from his hand/plate zone to her while the father conversation continues.
routes.zuv_active_role: He notices, does not pull the bite back, and looks at her face with amused softness instead of irritation.
routes.save_share_thesis: Love is when even the bite you made for yourself starts feeling like ours.

routes.title: Roti Custody Was Never Discussed
routes.universal_relationship_truth: Every couple has something whose ownership silently changes after love.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: She behaves like the opened roti bite has already been assigned to her.
routes.concrete_proof_beat: His hand prepares the bite; her hand calmly intercepts it.
routes.zuv_active_role: His look signs the invisible custody agreement.
routes.save_share_thesis: Some rights are not given. They just start existing.

routes.title: The Family Conversation Kept Going
routes.universal_relationship_truth: The funniest love stories happen quietly while the room is busy with something else.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: She keeps taking the bite while Zuv is talking to his father.
routes.concrete_proof_beat: Father is mid-conversation; the couple's silent food transfer plays underneath.
routes.zuv_active_role: He splits attention between respect at the table and softness toward her.
routes.save_share_thesis: Some love is a private scene inside a public room.

routes.title: He Learned The First Bite Was Shared
routes.universal_relationship_truth: The right person learns your tiny claims before you explain them.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: She takes the first prepared bite each time.
routes.concrete_proof_beat: He tears, she takes, the table keeps going.
routes.zuv_active_role: He lets the pattern become care instead of calling it out.
routes.save_share_thesis: Love learns the small rules of us.
routes.cap_reason: Too close to known 'extra bite / being known' food lane unless staged through father-table side story.

routes.title: My Plate Had No Boundary
routes.universal_relationship_truth: Couple life slowly removes small boundaries.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: She takes from his plate space naturally.
routes.concrete_proof_beat: The plate boundary disappears through the roti bite.
routes.cap_reason: Too generic as a couple-account food-sharing trope.

routes.title: She Took The Bite; He Took The Moment
routes.universal_relationship_truth: Sometimes love is noticing the person more than the thing they took.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: She keeps taking the prepared bite.
routes.concrete_proof_beat: The missing bite is less important than his gaze.
routes.zuv_active_role: His gaze turns the theft into tenderness.
routes.save_share_thesis: The bite disappeared; the softness stayed.

routes.title: Some Love Has Bite Rights
routes.universal_relationship_truth: The funniest couples have unspoken rights over each other's tiny things.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: Her bite rights activate as soon as the roti opens.
routes.concrete_proof_beat: Open roti bite, instant Aachu claim, Zuv's look.
routes.zuv_active_role: He keeps the scene gentle instead of transactional.
routes.save_share_thesis: Real love comes with invisible permissions.
routes.cap_reason: Clever phrase, but risks feeling like a meme label rather than a staged scene.

routes.title: The Roti Was Just The Messenger
routes.universal_relationship_truth: Objects only matter when they reveal the relationship.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: The roti bite keeps revealing her comfort with him.
routes.concrete_proof_beat: Roti bite moves across the table.
routes.zuv_active_role: He sees the meaning under the action.
routes.save_share_thesis: It was never about the food.
routes.cap_reason: Too abstract and object-first; the phrase is a known rescue pattern, not the best hook.

selector.reason: It preserves the raw event, avoids the rejected food-denial lane, has a clear visual object movement, gives Aachu playful agency without shaming her, and makes Zuv's look the emotional action.
